title: Lipschitz-free spaces over non-porous subsets of $\mathbb{R}^n$
summary: We prove that the Lipschitz-free space $\mathcal{F}(M)$ contains a complemented copy of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbb{Z}^n)$ whenever $M\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ is not porous. Consequently, if $M\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ is uniformly discrete and not porous then $\mathcal{F}(M)$ is isomorphic to $\mathcal{F}(\mathbb{Z}^n)$.
